name: Combo
description: Product group card shown in the #combos rail. Marketing creates and edits combos in Admin without touching code. Savings are computed from product compare-at prices in Liquid - never stored here.

field_definitions.name: Description
field_definitions.description: Optional short description under the title.

field_definitions.name: Products
field_definitions.description: Products in the combo, in display order. Prices and savings are read live from each product.

field_definitions.name: Badge text
field_definitions.description: Optional small flag on the card, e.g. "Most popular". Empty hides it.

field_definitions.name: Includes line
field_definitions.description: Label before the product count, e.g. "Includes".

field_definitions.name: Fine print
field_definitions.description: Small print under the price row, e.g. "Free shipping over Rs. 999".

field_definitions.name: CTA label
field_definitions.description: Button label, e.g. "Add combo to cart". Falls back to a sensible default when empty.

field_definitions.name: Is most popular
field_definitions.description: Highlights the card as the default/featured combo.
